# ApexUse — Computer Use MCP Server (apexuse-mcp)

> ApexUse is a local-first, open-source Computer Use MCP server (v0.3.0) written in pure Rust and native OS APIs for macOS (`arm64` & `x86_64`), Windows (`x86_64`), and Linux (`x86_64`). Gives AI coding agents (Antigravity, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, OpenCode) hybrid Accessibility + Set-of-Mark (`[m1]..[mN]`) visual grounding, native `set_value`/`select_text`, semantic `target` lookup, `keep_snapshot` form-ref reuse, default compact JPEG screenshots, batched `run_actions` (up to 24 steps), local `wait_for` polling, adaptive `verify_change` auto-retry, an independent floating `AgentCursor`, and workflow memory over MCP stdio with zero external Rust or npm dependencies.

## Core MCP Tools (`apexuse-mcp`)

- `inspect_app`: Read-only Accessibility snapshot (`e1..eN` refs, bounds, workflow hints) without taking a screenshot.
- `visual_inspect`: Captures window or `"desktop"`, fuses Accessibility + OCR (`ocr="auto"|"fast"|"accurate"|"off"`), overlays `[m1]..[mN]` badges, and returns annotated JPEG (`format="jpeg"`, `quality=80`, `max_width=1280` default) or opt-in PNG (`format="png"`) + mark index.
- `computer`: `inspect`, `click`, `double_click`, `right_click`, `hover`, `drag`, `type`, `set_value` (direct native text write/clear on verified editable fields; `text=""` clears, fails closed on unverified coordinates/OCR-only marks), `select_text` (optional `start`/`end`), `press_key`, target-scoped `scroll` (`ref`/`mark`/`x,y`), `run_actions` (up to 24 chained steps including inline `set_value`, `select_text`, `wait_for`, `inspect`, and `target`), `wait_for` (local AX/OCR poll up to 60s), `confirm`; supports `target: { query, role?, fresh? }`, `keep_snapshot`, `verify_change`, `max_retries`, `settle_ms`, `poll_interval_ms`, `retry_delay_ms`, `require_change`.
- `desktop`: `list_applications`, `launch_application`, `activate_application`, `open_url`, `visual_click`, `double_click`, `right_click`, `hover`, `drag` (supports `mark`, `ref`, `target`, or `x`/`y`).
- `screenshot`: Unannotated JPEG (default) or PNG window capture after safety preflight.
- `workflow_memory`: Non-secret structural macro recording and parameterized replay (`list`, `lookup`, `record`, `replay`, `clear`).

## OS Architecture

- macOS 14+ (`rust/native/macos_bridge.m`): `AXUIElement` (`kAXValueAttribute`/`kAXSelectedTextRangeAttribute`), `ScreenCaptureKit` (with resolution cap & 1500ms window cache), Apple `Vision` OCR, `ApexUseCursorView` overlay, per-PID `CGEvent`/`NSEvent` chunked Unicode typing. Live verified.
- Windows 10/11 (`rust/src/driver/windows.rs`): Pure-Rust Win32 FFI (`IUIAutomation` COM `ValuePattern`/`TextPattern`, `PrintWindow`/`BitBlt`, WinRT `Windows.Media.Ocr`, batched `SendInput`, layered `AgentCursor`, `som_png` codec). Cross-checked; CI build configured.
- Linux X11/Wayland (`rust/src/driver/linux.rs`): Runtime `dlopen` `libX11` / `libXtst`, `AT-SPI2` (`EditableText` / `Text` / `gi.repository.Atspi`), Wayland helpers (`grim`/`spectacle`/`gnome-screenshot`, `wtype`/`ydotool`), `tesseract` OCR, `som_png` codec. Cross-checked; CI build configured.

## Install, Wire & CLI

```sh
npx -y apexuse-mcp install all --write --npx --with-skill
npx -y apexuse-mcp doctor --check
npx -y apexuse-mcp config show
npx -y apexuse-mcp call inspect_app --args '{"app":"Calculator"}'
cargo install apexuse-mcp
cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
```
